rapport_notes: Jeline is professional and clear but delivers the call in a transactional, checklist-driven manner with minimal warmth or connection.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated; no process violations detected.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep launches directly into logistics questions ('when are you planning to do the move, sir?') with no framing, time-box, or promise of an accurate quote in exchange for the probing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' or any recognizable version of that line.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns raised by customer that would trigger follow-up; rep never created the opening for this to happen.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Rep asks about heavy items, valuables, and large appliances, but never asks 'What items in this move do you need us to be most careful with?' or delivers damage-coverage/carefulness messaging anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Not covered. No mention of 'Meet Your Mover,' a named crew lead, or who will be showing up.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not covered anywhere. Rep gives a range estimate ('three hours to four hours') but does not mention an on-time guarantee or make it a differentiator.
evidence_quotes.communication: Not covered. No mention of day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates, or proactive communication.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep says: 'I estimate to move to finish in three hours to four hours with the two movers... estimated cost is $699 to $907' — gives a range and names two movers, but does not personalize to the specific factors mentioned (third-floor storage, half-full unit, two-story condo, street parking, steps).
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Rep says: 'of course, this is only my estimate. If ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we used during the move.' — covers the idea that the estimate is not a hard ceiling.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Rep says: 'If ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we used during the move' — covers the refund/savings concept; 15-minute increment detail is embedded in the rate explanation earlier.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Not covered. No mention of pre-move customer prep reducing the bill.
evidence_quotes.does_that_feel_fair_then_silence: After the estimate, rep asks 'So with what would you like to be on the schedule?' — no 'does that feel fair' question and no deliberate silence held.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock: Not mentioned. No line about rate locking when the booking is confirmed.
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Rep asks 'So with what would you like to be on the schedule?' which is a scheduling question, not an explicit 'would you like our help with your move?' close. The call ends with 'anything else I can do for you today?' which is a generic handoff, not a conscious close.

top_strength: Jeline collected all logistical and inventory details methodically and delivered a clear, itemized pricing explanation that removes hidden-fee concerns.
coaching_note: This call skipped Discovery entirely — no quid pro quo, no agenda question, no two-layer follow-up — and jumped straight into logistics intake and pricing; rebuilding Stage 1 (especially the agenda line and genuine curiosity about concerns) is the highest-impact priority for Jeline.
